notes.notes: [p]Hello~! Good afternoon, this is the official website editor![/p][p]Today I will take you into the "Chinese Heroes" to learn about the changes in the new area![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45247758/2bc8e930c0749e05bfa3b9b48ceaa2682188340c.png"][/img][/p][p]Ten years is a long time for a game. Since the release of Chinese Heroes OL, it has carried the heroic dreams and fighting passion of countless players.[/p][p]It has been ten years since the first appearance of "Chinese Heroes OL". During this decade, many players have been quietly accompanying us and experiencing the ups and downs of the game world together. We know that every players expectation and trust are the driving force for us to keep moving forward.[/p][p]In the early days of the games return, we noticed that due to the particularity of the gameplay, there were some problems that were too challenging. After the first release, the difficulty of equipment enhancement and the transition of new players were the focus of our attention.[/p][p]As the "Listen to Advice" game operation team, we are always committed to providing the best game experience for players. Therefore, since the launch of the server, our official team has started to plan a comprehensive and in-depth optimization work for the game.[/p][p]We know that the balance of the game and the player experience are what we need to focus on most. We listen to every players voice, and we make careful adjustments to every detail of the game, reducing the difficulty in the early stages, adding more auxiliary items and tutorials, so that every new player can smoothly integrate into the world and experience the transition from weak to strong.[/p][p]So, lets talk about it! Let the editor take you to explore the specific content tuning that our planned kneeling modification of the zone includes![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45247758/3f5bedd778a181a0a9789c49255158f484086e93.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Equipment acquisition difficulty adjustment? Its true! No worries about early equipment![/p][p]Is it strange to see this title? Why is it called "No worries about early equipment"?[/p][p]The introduction of "Hero Zone" is all about one word: "fun"! It aims to divert players attention from leveling up to other aspects during the early stages of the game. Therefore, we have adjusted the equipment for the main quests in the early 100-level phase. The previous +10 equipment has been changed to +10 equipment for both the 40+8 and 70+8 levels![/p][p]The introduction is as follows:[/p][p]1. Reach level 20 and obtain 0+10 blue perfect equipment cards by completing the main quest "The Captured Master"[/p][p]2. Reach level 52 and obtain blue perfect equipment card of 40+10 by completing the main quest "Purple Dragon King who is immune to all poisons"[/p][p]3. Reach level 96 and obtain 70+10 blue perfect equipment cards by completing the main quest "Invincible in the Knife"[/p][p] [/p][p]Take more blood when you hang up the phone! Regaining blood should not be a source of anxiety for you![/p][p]Since the opening of the area, we have received the most feedback that "it is difficult to hang up and get blood back!", dont worry! Dont be anxious! Let your blood bag be enough![/p][p]In order to assist you, we have also optimized the new character bag! Different levels of blood medicine are set according to the level![/p][p]The introduction is as follows:[/p][p]Newbie Blood Circulation/Return Card (Contains level 0/20)[/p][p]Advanced Blood circulation/Return to the inner exchange card (including level 20/40)[/p][p]Jingzhen Blood Circulation/Return to Inner Exchange Card (including level 40/70)[/p][p]Break the boundary to activate blood circulation / exchange card (including level 70 / 100)[/p][p] [/p][p]The VIP price is unreasonable? The items are not discounted at all?[/p][p]Dear, Im already on the front line of the best deals here! Theres a way to buy blessing reinforcement scrolls at lower prices than the mall![/p][p]Because we received feedback from players that VIP gift package was unreasonable and more expensive than the price of buying it alone, we have greatly optimized the VIP gift package in China, including the items available in the gift package![/p][p]In the future, Chinese hero VIP will be listed independently! The price is more favorable[/p][p] [/p][p]The game mall may become a thing of the past! The web mall is coming soon![/p][p]In response to the suggestions and expectations of the majority of players, we will follow the opening of the hero server and open the online store together![/p][p]In the web store, you can choose to buy items directly or draw packets![/p][p]If you have any other items you want to buy directly, please let us know![/p][p] [/p][p]So, how can such a reasonable modification not play the hero zone![/p][p]Lets look forward to its arrival![/p][p] [/p]
